description: Customers report severe difficulties with returning damaged or incorrect items and tracking refunds, exacerbated by automated, unresponsive, or unhelpful customer support.

representative_quotes.quote: Sir/Madam, I bought Campus Vacuum Men Lace-Up Running Shoes on the Myntra website on 22/01/2026 for Rs. 1205. I received the delivery on 27/01/2026, and I placed a return request on the same day because the shoe sole was very hard and the size was too small. At the same price, there are much better shoes available on other platforms, so I decided to return it. For that return, Myntra sent me a message saying that their delivery agent would come and collect the return order on or before 30/01/2026. However, the delivery agent did not come and wasted a lot of my time. I complained about this issue to customer care. When the delivery agent finally came today, he rejected the return, saying that there were stains on the shoes. I strongly feel that since I complained about your delivery agent, my return order is being deliberately delayed by rejecting it without any valid reason. Such behaviour is highly unprofessional. I expect this issue to be addressed immediately and the return to be processed without further delay. Additionally, I request you to kindly look into this matter, and please check the stains if any can be found in the attached photos of the shoes I received. If anything is found wrong, I will follow your advice; otherwise, you will be responsible and answerable to this issue in the consumer court.

Very disappointing experience with Myntra. I ordered a dress, but I received the wrong product. I immediately raised a return request, but the return pickup is repeatedly being rescheduled without any proper resolution. I have contacted customer care multiple times, but I am not getting a satisfactory response. Every time I am asked to wait, while the pickup date keeps changing. This is extremely frustrating, especially when the mistake is clearly on Myntra’s side. I simply want my refund

I have complained multiple times that I have not received any refund amount in my bank.

If there were an option to give 0 stars, I would definitely give 0. I am extremely disappointed with Myntra's customer support. I have a genuine issue with my order/exchange, but there is no proper customer care number, no accessible customer support, and no effective way to get help. I even raised the issue through the grievance email, but no one has responded despite multiple follow-ups. For a major e-commerce platform, this level of customer support is extremely disappointing.
